newsitem.title: USA: US consumer debt issue not major concern-Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: US consumer debt issue not major concern-Greenspan.

text.p: Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan on Wednesday played down worries about the extent of consumer debt in the United States, saying the Fed did not see a broad economic threat from the situation.

"What clearly is occurring is a general moving up in certain selected areas of the consumer credit markets," Greenspan said when questioned by the Senate Banking Committee. "Overall, however, there does not seem to be a problem which is created any concern on our part."

The Fed chief did remark, however, on "some pressures" faced by debt holders in the lower-income brackets as he noted the pressures faced by richer debt holders were in part offset by the "wealth effect" from the stock market's surge.
